state:
- The editable event stays non-operational: Nup98 is named while phosphosites, the kinase, the TDP-43 de-mixing construct, the stress-granule scaffold, and the numeric equivalence and ranking margins stay deferred to later preregistration. Lock one S3-based construct, one scaffold gene, explicit margins, and a written joint score, and keep sites and the kinase as labeled assumptions.
- Temporal support is anchored to assembly onset and death markers, and the phospho-alleles lack a dosage-matched baseline without cytoplasmic assemblies, so a late correlate or a general NPC effect can meet the written criteria. Measure the phosphocluster against the first NLS-import decline and add phospho-null and phospho-mimetic arms in assembly-free neurons.
- The rank-first rule is written as a falsifier of Nup98, so a higher-scoring co-modified FG-nucleoporin discards the claim, and Arm 2 leaves the stress pulse undefined. Falsify Nup98 through failed rescue by the gated alleles, retain other nucleoporins as parallel hypotheses, and define Arm 2 as the same de-mixing construct plus one specified stressor.
